title: Warranty and boot-closing letdowns
summary: This topic centers on brief complaints about letdowns, with one clear issue about manual boot closing behind a costly upgrade and several incomplete mentions of warranty or broader dissatisfaction.

negative.summary: The clear negative feedback points to disappointment that manual boot closing requires paying for a more expensive upgrade.
